state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the childcare subsidy for a single parent with one child under six working 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q4: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q5: What flight fare limit applied to a standard return flight within Europe on 2026-02-15? (answer in EUR per return flight)
- Q6: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the daily meal allowance that applies to: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day with an approved client dinner today?

passages.source: HB-08 §1 | Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the daily meal allowance in HB-25. The travel office reviews the daily meal allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Managers confirm claims for the daily meal allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-25 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-41
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel is 50 EUR per day. Claims for the daily meal allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: meals'. The travel office publishes worked examples of the daily meal allowance on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-41 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-25
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel was 42 EUR per day. Managers confirm claims for the daily meal allowance before payment in the next payroll run. The travel office publishes worked examples of the daily meal allowance on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-08 §3 | Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to interns; they follow the standard daily meal allowance in HB-25 §2. Each claim for the daily meal allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. Managers confirm claims for the daily meal allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-41 §1 | Travel policy: meals — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-06-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-25
passages.text: This version set the daily meal allowance for all employees. Questions about the daily meal allowance go to the travel office, who keeps the record of decisions. The travel office publishes worked examples of the daily meal allowance on the intranet.
